req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid title yields 201; (2) negative EP — missing title key yields 422; (3) BVA boundary — empty string title (length=0, below min_length=1) yields 422; (4) DT — null/None title yields 422; (5) NEG — whitespace-only title with length>=1 is accepted (422 is NOT returned). Each test asserts exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with a valid non-empty title
expected: response body contains id, title, completed=false
trace: R-TASK-002 — positive path: valid title must not trigger 422
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in body

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422
actions: POST /tasks/ with no title key in payload
expected: response body contains detail about missing field
trace: R-TASK-002 — primary error pathway: missing title must yield 422
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    payload = {"description": "some description", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    # Verify the error references the title field
    detail_str = str(body["detail"])
    assert "title" in detail_str
